 Computational analysis via DharmaNexus indicates 125 instances of internal Pali text reuse shared among eight other sections of the *Milindapañha* [DharmaNexus]. The most substantial internal overlaps occur with the *Vessantarapañha* (Mil 6.3.1; §4.8–5.1 sharing material with §26.4–27.1) and the *Katādhikārasaphalapañha* (Mil 5.1.1; §3.3_2–4.1 sharing with §14.3_5–15.1), alongside phraseological parallels with the *Akālamaraṇapañha* (Mil 6.3.6) and *Nibbānarūpasaṇṭhānapañha* (Mil 6.3.10) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also aligns segments of the text with Tibetan canonical texts, including the *Pitāputrasamāgamasūtra* (D0060), the *Vinayavibhaṅga* (D0003), and the *Vinayasaṃgraha* (D4105), though these represent machine alignments rather than established parallels [DharmaNexus].
